evidence.note: Dozens of ~1 px light-grey spokes fan from tiny (~4 px) hollow agent dots into the package mirror; at this size they read as hairlines and specks.
Thin blue and pale-grey hairline spokes plus thin-stroke outlined folder and document icons, all fine detail that compression would smear.
'PUBLIC INTERNET' label is small, very pale grey on near-white, barely legible; globe and arrow are faint thin strokes.
Title, timeline text and callout quote are generous and high contrast; paper feel comes from flat colour, no grain.

rationale: Type and panels are mostly generous and grain-free, but the core diagram relies on many 1 px pale spokes, tiny dots and thin-stroke icons. A faint, small 'PUBLIC INTERNET' label adds low-contrast small text. Those are the hairlines and faint text the fail descriptor names, and compression at a small viewer size would erase them.
